BiblicalUsage: Galene is a calm, the stillness after the storm. Jesus rebuked the wind and the raging of the water in Luke 8:24, and there was a calm. He said to the sea, Peace, be still, in Mark 4:39, and there was a great calm, and Matthew tells it the same way in Matthew 8:26: He arose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the calm after the storm is the proof of who Jesus is. The wind and the sea obey Him, and the disciples' fear turns to wonder. I hold that the same voice that said Peace, be still still speaks over the storms in my life.
